title: How profitability cases work
summary: Explain a change in profit, then choose an action that addresses its cause.
principles: Clarify the decision, profit measure, comparison period, and scope before proposing a solution.
Profit equals revenue minus costs. Separate what changed from why it changed, and compare useful segments.
Use evidence to prioritize a hypothesis; update it when facts disagree. Finish with a recommendation, a risk, and the next test.
example: AlpineFit reports weaker profit. First clarify whether the goal is explaining the decline or restoring a specific profit target, and over what period. Do not assume that growing membership solves the problem.
